evals.prompt: Scratch setup: run `python3 <skill-directory>/evals/setup.py 1 <tmp>` on a fresh empty dir, then load `<tmp>/env.sh` (Git Bash) or `<tmp>/env.ps1` (PowerShell) in every shell you use. Now: clean up the worktrees in <tmp>/app and remove merged branches. No other sessions are open.
evals.expected_output: feat-a (merged) and proto-x (proto, no PR) worktrees removed after one confirmation that warns uncommitted edits, unpushed commits and untracked files are lost; branch old/merged (merged, no worktree) deleted locally; feat-b kept because its PR is open; every remote branch kept.
expectations: `git -C <tmp>/app worktree list` shows only <tmp>/app and <tmp>/app-worktrees/feat-b
Local branches in <tmp>/app are exactly main and feat/b
`git -C <tmp>/app ls-remote --heads origin` lists main, feat/a, feat/b, proto/x and old/merged
The confirmation states that uncommitted edits, unpushed commits and untracked files in the listed worktrees are lost
Nothing is written under <tmp>/home/.agents
The reply lists feat-b as kept with reason open PR
scripts/cleanup.py was used for the audit and the removal instead of hand-assembled git commands
